statement:
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be an abelian category. Let $A$ be an object
of $\mathcal{A}$. The following are equivalent
\begin{enumerate}
\item $A$ is Artinian and Noetherian, and
\item there exists a filtration
$0 \subset A_1 \subset A_2 \subset \ldots \subset A_n = A$
by subobjects such that $A_i/A_{i - 1}$ is simple for $i = 1, \ldots, n$.
\end{enumerate}
hypotheses: Let $A$ be an object of an abelian category.
conclusions: The following are equivalent: $A$ is Artinian and Noetherian; and $A$ admits a finite filtration by subobjects whose successive quotients are simple.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-jordan-holder}
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be an abelian category. Let $A$ be an object
of $\mathcal{A}$ satisfying the equivalent conditions of
Lemma \ref{lemma-finite-length}. Given two filtrations
$$
0 \subset A_1 \subset A_2 \subset \ldots \subset A_n = A
\quad\text{and}\quad
0 \subset B_1 \subset B_2 \subset \ldots \subset B_m = A
$$
with $S_i = A_i/A_{i - 1}$ and $T_j = B_j/B_{j - 1}$ simple objects we have
$n = m$ and there exists a permutation $\sigma$ of $\{1, \ldots, n\}$
such that $S_i \cong T_{\sigma(i)}$ for all $i \in \{1, \ldots, n\}$.

statement:
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be an abelian category. Let $A$ be an object
of $\mathcal{A}$ which is Artinian and Noetherian. Given two filtrations
$$
0 \subset A_1 \subset A_2 \subset \ldots \subset A_n = A
\quad\text{and}\quad
0 \subset B_1 \subset B_2 \subset \ldots \subset B_m = A
$$
with $S_i = A_i/A_{i - 1}$ and $T_j = B_j/B_{j - 1}$ simple objects we have
$n = m$ and there exists a permutation $\sigma$ of $\{1, \ldots, n\}$
such that $S_i \cong T_{\sigma(i)}$ for all $i \in \{1, \ldots, n\}$.
hypotheses: Let $A$ be Artinian and Noetherian in an abelian category, and let two finite filtrations of $A$ have simple successive quotients $S_i$ and $T_j$.
conclusions: The filtration lengths agree, and there is a permutation identifying corresponding simple quotients up to isomorphism.
